item.description:
Thimble 0.9.4 makes pictures quicker to scroll and sharper in their tiles.
- Picture grids and the Overview stay smooth while pictures load, on the Mac, iPhone, and iPad. - A wide picture stays sharp when it's cropped into a square tile. - A photo taken with the iPhone or iPad camera is kept upright, and saved faster. - A picture that hasn't reached this device yet says "Not here yet", and one that's still loading shows a plain tile instead. - Your Sync Key and passphrase stay in this device's Keychain as before, and nothing needs to be entered again.
